comment: Deterministic regression scenarios for run-regression.js. Each runs under the shared determinism policy (governor off, test resolution, gate off, fluid material, seeded RNG, frozen clock). Action vocabulary: slider/checkbox/select/preset/material/stroke/pointerStroke/key/step/clear/snapshot/eval. Grow this list one scenario per feature system — the features inventory (inventory/features.json) lists the activation recipes.

scenarios.name: plain-stroke
scenarios.comment: The canonical baseline: one seeded stroke, advected 60 frames.

scenarios.name: pointer-stroke
scenarios.comment: Same idea through the REAL input pipeline (05d handlers, brush engine spacing) — catches input-path regressions the splat path cannot.

scenarios.name: materials
scenarios.comment: One stroke per material. setMode must follow any snapshot apply, never precede it (material-vs-snapshot ordering, 29-material-modes).

scenarios.name: builtin-presets
scenarios.comment: Two contrast-extreme built-ins over the same stroke.

scenarios.name: multi-arm-radial
scenarios.comment: Six-arm radial symmetry through the splat multiplier.

scenarios.name: collider-lattice
scenarios.comment: Procedural obstacle field, stroke driven through it. setProcedural flips collision on itself; the reset between scenarios clears it via the next scenario's clear (obstacle texture wipe is in the features inventory if this ever leaks).

scenarios.name: kaleido-display
scenarios.comment: Kaleidoscope is display-chain: sim hashes should MATCH plain-stroke's physics under identical input while the display hash differs. First-enable side effect: the kaleido toggle bootstraps multiplier to 8 — pinned back to 1 here explicitly.

scenarios.name: hotkey-freeze-toggle
scenarios.comment: Space stops the fluid (toggleFreeze). Snapshot while frozen must equal snapshot after more steps (nothing advances), then unfreeze.
